title: PR Plan
description: Input shape for scripts/pr_readiness.mjs — a normalized description of a pull request's narrative, diff shape, CI checks, review state, and landing mechanics.

hasSummary.description: True if the PR body has a non-boilerplate ## Summary section.

hasTestPlan.description: True if the PR body has a non-boilerplate ## Test Plan section.

testPlanHasEvidence.description: True only if the Test Plan carries real evidence (command output, exit code, artifact path/screenshot), not a bare claim.

mixedConcerns.description: True if the diff bundles unrelated concerns (e.g. refactor + feature + dependency bump).

required.description: True if this is a required context in branch protection.

external.description: True if the check is run by a system outside repo CI (e.g. Cloudflare Pages preview build) and should never gate a merge.

mergeMethod.description: How the PR was (or would be) merged. "queue" (or empty/null) means the merge queue's configured strategy decided; any other value means an agent forced a specific strategy by hand.

usedAdminBypass.description: True if an admin override (e.g. gh pr merge --admin) bypassed branch protection.

forcePushed.description: True if the branch was force-pushed after review or CI ran against it.

rebasedOnLatestBase.description: True if the branch has been rebased onto the latest base branch before the mergeability check.
